name: Having A Covering
overview: Having a covering in Scripture reveals the divine order and protection established by God. From creation, mankind is made in God's image, male and female, reflecting His design and authority. Believers are called to dwell under God's protective shadow, symbolizing His shelter and care. This covering extends to submitting to governing authorities as ordained by God, and ultimately following Christ's example of seeking the Father's will rather than one's own, demonstrating dependence on divine guidance and authority.
